name: internet-tools
description: DNS, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail blocklist, WHOIS, TLS certificate and HTTP security header checks against live public resolvers, with the fix for each finding.

interface.shortDescription: Check DNS, email authentication, blocklists and TLS
interface.longDescription: Looks up DNS records and propagation, DNSSEC, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, mail blocklists, WHOIS, TLS certificates and HTTP security headers against live public resolvers. Every finding comes with a level, a plain message and, where there is one, the fix. Read-only, no account.
defaultPrompt: Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC for example.com and tell me what to fix.
When does the certificate on example.com expire? Is the chain complete?
